name: ST Elementor Addons
author: Kristyna Bennett

sections.description:
ST Elementor Addons is a lightweight plugin that adds a variety of customizable widgets to Elementor, designed to enhance the functionality and interactivity of your website. The plugin includes:

  • Custom Button Widget: Quickly add a button with customizable text, URL, and alignment options (left, center, or right).
  • Marquee Widget: Create a scrolling text, icon, or image with a smooth marquee effect.
  • Dynamic Tags Support: Use Elementor dynamic tags to display content dynamically from posts, custom fields, and other sources.
  • Flexbox Carousel: A flexible carousel widget built with Elementor’s container system, allowing you to drag and drop any Elementor widget into the carousel for a fully customizable slider.

This plugin is perfect for users who want to add interactive elements to their Elementor-powered website without the need for complicated configurations.

Features

  • Fully customizable button widget with options for text, URL, and alignment.
  • Marquee widget for scrolling text, icons, or images.
  • Dynamic Tags support to pull dynamic content into widgets directly within Elementor.
  • Flexbox Carousel: Build sliders using Elementor containers and insert any widgets inside.
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance.
  • Follows WordPress coding standards.
  • Translation ready with .pot files.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/st-elementor-addons directory or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor editor and search for the widgets: “ST Button”, “ST Marquee”, “ST Flexbox Carousel”.
  4. Drag and drop the widgets onto your page and customize them as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, this plugin works as an addon for Elementor and requires Elementor to be installed and activated.

Can I use this plugin with any theme?

Yes, as long as the theme supports Elementor, this plugin will work seamlessly.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready. You can translate it into your language using .pot files.

How do I use Dynamic Tags in this plugin?

Dynamic Tags can be used within the plugin’s widgets by selecting the “Dynamic Tags” option from the widget settings. This allows you to pull dynamic content such as post titles, author names, custom fields, and more directly into your widgets.

What is the Flexbox Carousel?

The Flexbox Carousel is a powerful Elementor container-based carousel. You can easily add any Elementor widget inside the carousel, and it will automatically display as a draggable, scrollable slider. It’s flexible, responsive, and fully customizable.
